For each deployment in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence DESCRIPTION an engineer would log in a change ticket: what was deployed and to what, in plain engineering language. Do not invent outcomes (success/failure) beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"deployments": [{"i": <int>, "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.
